Question 11
?

Let P={y0,y1,…,yn} be a partition of the interval [1,5]. If Δyj=yj−yj−1, calculate ∑j=1n(yj+yj−1)Δyj.

a
21
b
28
c
18
d
24
e
16
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We can simplify the given summation as follows:

∑j=1n(yj+yj−1)Δyj=(y1+y0)Δy1+(y2+y1)Δy2+⋯+(yn+yn−1)Δyn=(y1+y0)(y1−y0)+(y2+y1)(y2−y1)+⋯+(yn+yn−1)(yn−yn−1)=(y12−y02)+(y22−y12)+⋯+(yn2−yn−12)=(y12−y02)+(y22−y12)+⋯+(yn2−yn−12)=−y02+yn2=yn2−y02

Now, since y0=1 and yn=5 are the endpoints of our partition, we have

∑j=1n(yj+yj−1)Δyi=yn2−y02=52−12=24.
